memory_update.text: HSTM should be carried forward as the cleanest underfollowed pure-play candidate for healthcare workforce credentialing, compliance learning, and provider credentialing software.

ATGE is not a credentialing vendor, but it is a licensure-linked healthcare education operator whose value proposition depends on regulated career outcomes; carry forward as an adjacent regulated-outcomes candidate.

STRA is an adjacent employer-workforce education platform candidate; the key verification question is whether Workforce Edge and Sophia create durable verified-credit / employer-ROI infrastructure rather than generic online education exposure.
Pearson / PSO is the reference benchmark for high-stakes assessment and professional certification delivery, useful for mapping smaller credentialing and compliance software suppliers.

Further searches should target proctoring vendors, background / license verification vendors, nursing exam-prep providers, continuing-education compliance systems, and private-to-public supplier dependencies; many may be embedded inside HR tech, healthcare SaaS, or information-services labels.

node: Credentialing, assessment, licensure prep, proctoring, and compliance data
summary: Layer 1B expands the credentialing / assessment / compliance node with a two-lane universe. Pearson is the reference anchor for high-stakes testing infrastructure. The underfollowed lane is more interesting: HealthStream is a direct healthcare workforce credentialing and compliance SaaS candidate; Adtalem is a healthcare licensure-driven education operator whose outcomes depend on regulated exams and professional eligibility; Strategic Education is an adjacent workforce-benefits and credit-transfer platform where employer-linked education records may become more valuable if verified workforce ROI becomes a chokepoint. These are research candidates only, not recommendations.
